findings.summary: Every personal expense has a synthesized proxy line, so has_items treated a plain expense moved into a group as a receipt (Percentage/Adjustment and amount edits refused). Fixed: receipt = itemized, multi-line or any line with original_price.

Group PUT re-checked receipt totals even when the amount was unchanged; old receipts whose stored figures do not add up (tax lost by the old items PUT, personal receipts moved to a group) were locked against every edit, and moved personal receipts were converted with the group arithmetic. Fixed: plain edits keep the stored amount exactly; legacy view replays per origin (assignment rows = group-made) and shows any shortfall as tax.

Item insights derived from shares were not moved on a split/items edit, so delete backed out the wrong amounts. Fixed: both edit routes back out old item shares and add new ones (totals only, no duplicate price history).
Web and mobile edit forms saved every receipt edit as an Exact split, losing Equal/Shares. Fixed for receipts: payers/split sent only when the picker changed (manual expenses unchanged).

Personal PUT /expenses/{id} could change a receipt's amount without the totals rule and overwrote a one-line receipt's line. Fixed: amount change refused with totals_mismatch; receipt lines never overwritten there.
Group PUT on a receipt could move the amount by up to 0.02 without an items edit. Fixed by the exact-amount rule (F1).
Personal items PUT silently ignored split. Fixed: 400.
MCP get_expense mixed discount meanings. Fixed: item original_price exposed (null marks old format); tool spec updated.
MCP save rounded paid unit price half-even. Fixed: ROUND_HALF_UP.
Edit dialogs save items PUT then expense PUT; a failure of the second leaves a half-edit (pattern pre-existed). Not fixed: error is shown and the list refetches; single server call is a follow-up.
Unparseable AI/OCR numbers could 500 a scan after quota is charged. Fixed: lines flagged with a warning and skipped.
reject_item_assignments ran before authentication. Fixed: depends on auth_required.
MCP subtotal before a whole-receipt discount was refused after folding. Fixed: subtotal folded with the discount.
% and remove buttons below target size; % had no visible hint. Fixed: 32px web targets + tooltip, 44pt mobile targets.
Warning/success caption contrast. Dismissed: project tokens measured 5.02:1 (#B45309, #15803D on white) and >11:1 in dark mode.

Blocking status announcement. Fixed: detail sheet Save aria-describedby the status; mobile status is alert only when mismatched, polite live region. Quick Capture Save not linked (status sits directly above it).
Focus after split_required. Fixed: focus moves to 'Split the new total'.
Original-price row alignment at 320px / large text; mobile field lacks currency adornment.
Read-only items sheet said 'before saving'. Fixed wording.
Spec/architecture still described the removed engine, board and suggestion DTOs. Fixed.
MCP spec said 'net line total'. Fixed with original_price wording.
Paid unit price stale after a manual price edit. Fixed in prepare_lines.
AddExpenseForm group branch records the total only if a scan draft ever reaches it (judged unreachable, K8).
split_required has no handler on mobile edit (proactive split makes it unreachable today).
Deleting a receipt moved in from personal backed out group item insights it never added. Fixed: on move, item totals move from the owner's full amount to each member's share.
An old one-line item-split receipt stopped being a receipt after a re-split. Fixed: assignment rows also mark a receipt (single and list paths).
A whole-receipt discount larger than the lines lowered the MCP subtotal by the full discount. Fixed: only the absorbed amount comes off.
Item-insight totals were adjusted in float. Fixed: Decimal arithmetic.
